migration.description: Durable proxy routing projection and atomic terminal recovery obligations

durable_state.description: Existing terminal JSONL with begin/terminal events; encrypted proxy-route-facts-v1 sidecar; account generation and audit identity columns
durable_state.storage_implementation: SQLite plus authenticated append-only sidecar files beside the terminal journal

source_compatibility_range.from_program_versions: v4.5.x terminal-journal and SQLite layouts, including supported legacy account schemas
source_compatibility_range.to_program_version: next stable minor selected by repository release policy

ddl_structural_changes.description: Idempotently add account runtime_routing_generation DEFAULT 0 and nullable audit runtime_event_key with unique partial index; install column-aware account/group/global control triggers in existing tables

progress_signals: Fail-closed startup errors preserve source files
pause_points: Before listener readiness on schema or recovery failure
Between committed materialization batches; confirmed pending events remain durable

recovery.rollback_precondition: Drain confirmed routing sidecar events before running a release that cannot replay them; otherwise preserve files and repair forward

required_test_evidence: Terminal JSONL recovery compatibility and idempotence
Routing sidecar reopen replay, authenticated metadata and audit deduplication
Account disable-enable and sticky ownership fences
